dedupe_keys.name: swiss distribution grid distributed energy resources 2030 2050

description: The SwissDN-DERs team publishes projected distributed-resource allocations for Swiss medium- and low-voltage distribution grids in 2030, 2040 and 2050. The associated documentation describes photovoltaic panels, batteries, heat pumps, electric vehicles, non-controllable loads and temperature profiles mapped to grid nodes. The descriptor reports 57 CSV files, with nineteen for each projected year. The current Zenodo release is free under CC BY 4.0. It can supply spatially detailed future inputs for distribution-grid capacity and flexibility simulations; model-pypsa-eur is a related planning model at a different network scale. A caveat is that these are scenarios, not installed-asset observations. Assumed adoption, node mapping and input grid versions determine whether a local feeder has plausible loading. The own repository metadata and generating-code README were read; the ZIP and row-level coverage were not checked. The release reopens a round 1 candidate rejected under an earlier single-study rule.
